appearance.explanation: Compare the cone volume with one sphere volume. Cone volume=(1/3)π·12²·24=1152π. Each sphere has r=3, volume=(4/3)π·3³=36π. Count=1152/36=32. Verified solution (unofficial); original PDF and derivation reviewed26October2026.
